speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN)

With normal cardiac, renal, meconium, and genetic workups, and considering the commonality of delayed lung fluid clearance in term or late-preterm infants, TTN remains the most likely diagnosis. I will monitor the infant's respiratory rate and oxygen saturation closely while providing supportive care; a repeat chest X-ray may be considered if symptoms do not improve within 24 to 48 hours.
